story: Do Geneva's official transaction prices tell the same long-term story as professional Swiss property indices?

lr_01_normalized_trend.title: Apartment prices since 1990: Geneva city, canton and Swiss benchmarks
lr_01_normalized_trend.note: PPE: OCSTAT = calendar-year median CHF/m² (ensemble to 2005, existing+libre from 2006). Wüest = published annual hedonic TPI (1985=100), rebased 1990=100. End labels: nominal + real CAGR (Geneva CPI annual mean).

lr_02_yoy_growth.title: Annual growth rate: Geneva vs Swiss benchmarks
lr_02_yoy_growth.note: BFS IMPI condo starts ~2017. Levels need not match across methods — shared direction and cycles confirm the trend.

lr_03_relative_performance.title: Geneva relative to Switzerland (Wüest and BIS)
lr_03_relative_performance.note: Solid: Lake Geneva / Switzerland (Wüest, single method). Dashed: OCSTAT / BIS (cross-method). Above 100 = outperformance since 1990.

lr_04_open_official.title: Open official Swiss indices vs Geneva (recent window)
lr_04_open_official.note: BIS RPP and BFS IMPI = freely available official data. Short history — recent validation only, not a full cycle.

lr_05_drawdowns.title: Drawdowns from peak: depth and duration
lr_05_drawdowns.subtitle_bottom: Episode map: how deep × how long
lr_05_drawdowns.note: Drawdown = % below running peak of index (1990=100). Episodes with depth ≥ 3%. Apartments (PPE) series.

lr_06_houses_trend.title: House prices since 1990: Geneva canton vs Swiss benchmarks
lr_06_houses_trend.note: Houses only + Geneva CPI. OCSTAT = median CHF/object; real CAGR uses Geneva CPI. Not level-comparable to PPE CHF/m².

lr_07_prices_vs_costs.title: Inflation and construction costs: Geneva vs Switzerland
lr_07_prices_vs_costs.note: Geneva CPI and Switzerland CPI (T 05.02.02, annual mean). Geneva housing construction cost (T 05.03.1.01). No transaction prices — see lr_01 / lr_06.

lr_08_implied_size.title: Implied typical apartment size: new vs existing (Geneva canton)
lr_08_implied_size.note: Proxy: OCSTAT median object price (kCHF)×1000 / median CHF/m², same segment (T 05.05.1.4.01). Not median floor area. Neufs vs non-neufs from 2006. End labels: level + CAGR over available span.
